note: Every capability a signed-in Decko user has, taken from Decko's own browser tests (the reference checkout's Cypress specs under spec/cypress/e2e and its Cucumber features under features/, source C:/localProjects/decko-ruby-reference/decko) and from this repo's 51 user journeys (reference-harness/browser/journeys/synthetic-v1.json). The gems in decko-ruby-oracle-gems ship no spec or feature directories. status: covered = a check in tools/edge-signed-in-exercise.mjs observes it; partial = some of it is observed; not_covered = no check yet; disabled_upstream = the upstream test is commented out; out_of_scope = needs something the local harness cannot provide, with the reason given.
